model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, steps on the back, front, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, bracket sets 斗拱 as a painted band. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 如园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鑑園西南為如園門三楹西嚮内為敦素堂堂北稍東為冠霞閣又東為明漪樓（長春園册）臣等謹案由如園山徑西行即澹懐堂之東垣門
evidence.summary: South-west of 鑑園: 如園 with a three-bay west-facing gate, 敦素堂, 冠霞閣 and 明漪樓; a hill path west reaches the east wall gate of 澹懐堂.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 门, 3x1 cells.
